role: Speculative enquiry: graduate / junior civil site role
cover_letter_text:
Hello,
I am asking whether Quantum Civil has junior or graduate civil site work available, not applying for an advertised vacancy. Your careers page invites expressions of interest from people who are just starting out and eager to learn.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as project-in-charge and then field engineer. As project-in-charge I coordinated 10 to 15 workers each day, reviewed structural and architectural drawings, and carried out site inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring. As field engineer I assisted with site inspections and quality checks, tracked procurement and materials, and prepared site reports and progress reports. In February 2026 I completed the Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, where I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019).

I am based in Melton VIC. I can start two weeks after an offer. Full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa), no sponsorship needed. I hold a full Victorian driver's licence and a White Card. Could we arrange a short call about junior site work?
Marc Masarate
